result.detail:
Decisions and gaps:
(1) Interface spec section 8 and microarchitecture section 5 ask for an unbounded SymbiYosys proof with covers. This task's expected outputs are only rtl_source and testbench, so I submitted no .sby. The proof should be a follow-up task. Until then, nothing is formally proven.
(2) irq is the combinational OR of flops, as the microarchitecture says. It is not registered, which the general knowledge document would suggest; following the approved spec avoids a one-cycle lag the interface spec does not allow.
(3) Address decode: idx = paddr[5:2]. An address is mapped only when it is aligned, has no bits set above bit 5, and idx is 8 or less. The testbench checks the alias addresses 0x40, 0x44, 0x4C, 0x60, 0x80 and 0xA0, plus unaligned addresses.
(4) Both files carry a timescale directive so Verilator does not flag TIMESCALEMOD. The RTL ends with default_nettype wire.
(5) The testbench uses #/@ timing inside tasks, so Verilator needs --timing (or --binary). Icarus needs SystemVerilog mode for $error.
(6) Reset is applied only while psel is low, as spec section 7 requires, so there is no reset in the middle of a transfer.
